name: Drutopia Organization
description: Config-only Features module that ships an Organization content type (for groups, nonprofits, businesses) with its fields, form/view displays, a Search API-backed listing view with an organization facet, pathauto patterns, organization/organization_type taxonomy vocabularies, and a contributor role permission grant; part of the Drutopia distribution.
project_description: Drutopia Organization is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia') of the Drutopia distribution. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP, routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports an Organization node type (for profiling groups, nonprofits and businesses), its fields (title as 'Organization name', a required summary, a text-with-summary body, a paragraph-based Description body, an image with focal point, an organization_type taxonomy reference, a topics reference and meta tags), a default form display plus five view displays (default/full/teaser/small_card/search_index), a Search API index and a listing view (view.organization) at /organization with an organization facet, two pathauto URL patterns, 'organization' and 'organization_type' taxonomy vocabularies, an 'Add organization' action link, and a config action that grants create/edit-own/delete-own organization permissions to the Drutopia contributor role. It also ships optional config adding a field_organization node reference on the Event type. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the full Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core, drutopia_event, drutopia_seo plus ds, facets, field_group, paragraphs, inline_entity_form, focal_point, pathauto, metatag, search_api and more) and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
